In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skeebo]] to rescue [[Anachro]]. However, Fett was forced to fight [[Ry-Kooda]] after the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] tracked him down.
